t: The Cooke & Lewis Bude lever on backplate door handle pair brings a bold, modern look to any interior. Crafted with a durable aluminium and steel build, it offers strength without compromising on style. Fire rated for 30 and 60 minutes when fitted to suitable timber doors, it provides extra reassurance without compromising on style. The matt black finish delivers a modern look, while the ergonomic lever ensures smooth, comfortable operation. Easy to install with standard fittings and suitable for use with a tubular mortice latch, this handle is a practical and stylish upgrade for any timber door.
b: Fire Door Rating: FD30, FD60 (Timber) & Not Suitable for Steel Fire Doors
Durable Finish to Resist Tarnishing & Wear
